hypotheses.claim: Port-Hamiltonian skew-coupling (kappa=6.0) produces an acoustic delta distinct from uncoupled (kappa=0.0) when holding +0.70 dB shelf identical.
Subtlety is an actuator magnitude scaling limit rather than machinery failure. Expanding swing from 6% to 18% elevates coupling delta above psychoacoustic masking without violating passivity.
Acoustic-scene pre-assessor reliably detects when processing helps, harms, or does nothing useful.
